classes.label: Class B common stock
classes.pricedAsReason: Class B is unlisted and converts into Class A one-for-one (2026 proxy: "Each outstanding share of Class B common stock is convertible at any time at the option of the holder into one share of Class A common stock."); its liquidation and dividend rights are identical to Class A.

notes: Class A trades on Nasdaq as ABNB. The 9,200,000 non-voting Class H shares are left out: all are held by Airbnb's wholly-owned Host Endowment Fund subsidiary (FY2025 10-K, Item 5), and net income per share is computed only for Class A and Class B. No Class C shares are outstanding.
